result.oneSentenceSummary: add_members creates duplicate group memberships and is not atomic
result.improvedCode:
def add_members
    group = Group.find(params.require(:group_id).to_i)
    usernames = params.require(:usernames)

    return can_not_modify_automatic if group.automatic

    Group.transaction do
      existing_ids = group.user_ids
      usernames.split(",").each do |username|
        if user = User.find_by_username(username)
          unless existing_ids.include?(user.id)
            group.add(user)
            existing_ids << user.id
          end
        end
      end

      if group.save
        render json: success_json
      else
        render_json_error(group)
      end
    end
  end

judge.titleReason: The title names both parts of the defect: duplicate membership insertion when existing or repeated users are not skipped, and the lack of atomicity.

def submit(self, message: Message[KafkaPayload | FilteredPayload]) -> None:
        if isinstance(message.value, FilteredPayload):
            return

        assert isinstance(message.value, BrokerValue)
        partition = message.value.partition
        offset = message.value.offset

        if isinstance(message.payload, FilteredPayload):
            self.queue_pool.offset_tracker.add_offset(partition, offset)
            self.queue_pool.offset_tracker.complete_offset(partition, offset)
            return

        try:
            result = self.decoder(message.payload)

            if result is None:
                self.queue_pool.offset_tracker.add_offset(partition, offset)
                self.queue_pool.offset_tracker.complete_offset(partition, offset)
                return

            group_key = self.grouping_fn(result)

            work_item = WorkItem(
                partition=partition,
                offset=offset,
                result=result,
                message=message,
            )

            self.queue_pool.submit(group_key, work_item)

        except Exception:
            logger.exception("Error submitting message to queue")
            self.queue_pool.offset_tracker.add_offset(partition, offset)
            self.queue_pool.offset_tracker.complete_offset(partition, offset)

result.oneSentenceSummary: count() matching misses aliased or whitespace-variant aggregates
result.improvedCode:
def transform_query_columns_for_error_upsampling(
    query_columns: Sequence[str],
) -> list[str]:
    """
    Transform aggregation functions to use sum(sample_weight) instead of count()
    for error upsampling. Only called when all projects are allowlisted.
    """
    import re

    count_pattern = re.compile(
        r"^\s*count\s*\(\s*\)\s*(?:as\s+(?P<alias>.+?))?\s*$", re.IGNORECASE
    )
    transformed_columns = []
    for column in query_columns:
        match = count_pattern.match(column)

        if match:
            # Count becomes sum of sample weights, preserving any existing alias
            alias = match.group("alias") or "count"
            transformed_columns.append(f"upsampled_count() as {alias}")

        else:
            transformed_columns.append(column)

    return transformed_columns

judge.titleReason: The title names the defect: the literal `count()` matching misses aliased and whitespace-variant forms of the aggregate.
judge.fixReason: The case-insensitive full-string regex rewrites `count()` with inner or surrounding whitespace and optional aliases, keeps the alias's original case, defaults to `count`, and leaves other columns unchanged and in order.
